title: Toast & Smarter Scan
changes: Scan result now appears as a toast that dismisses itself after a few seconds.
Open MetaTrader and MetaEditor show a waiting state while Wine starts up.
Toolbar button renamed from "Open MT" to "Open MetaTrader".
Auto-scan after a broker install now waits for the installer to finish instead of running too early.
Duplicate dialog no longer asks for a manual scan while auto-scan is already running.

title: Tick & Cache Scan
changes: Scan ticks and cache data files
Utility: Clear Cache and Clear Ticks removes all scanned files.

title: Fix & What's New
changes: Double window guard on MT Manager.

title: Fix Bug
changes: Double window guard on MT Install window.

title: UI Stability
changes: Scroll synchronization on three-Treeview tables is smoother.
White line artifacts on some dialogs removed.
